prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL Warcraft painted illustration for a Hunter Tier 3 Cryptstalker goal banner, 4:3 landscape.
Reference roles: Image 1 is ONLY the kneeling hunter/pet companionship pose and painted Warcraft style, not its clothing or purple pet. Image 2 precisely defines the WHITE Echeyakee lion. Images 3-5 precisely define the troll's Cryptstalker armor, anatomy, face, mohawk and kneeling posture from multiple angles. Study all armor references closely.
Scene: the Barrens in Warcraft, dry savanna grasses, dusty ground, distant flat-topped acacia and rugged mesas, natural atmospheric depth.
Subjects: exactly one male troll hunter kneeling beside exactly one white male lion companion. The lion sits/crouches at the hunter's side, lion head in front, hunter rests one anatomically correct hand gently on its upper back/mane as in reference 1. Hunter is blue-skinned (translated to grayscale), lean with long limbs, long pointed ears, protruding upward ivory tusks, tall purple mohawk (translated to grayscale), exposed two-toed troll feet. Show both recognizable faces and armor clearly.
Armor accuracy is essential: wear the exact Hunter Tier 3 Cryptstalker from images 3-5, not generic fantasy armor. Preserve the distinct angular layered bronze/orange chitin plates and violet inset motifs translated to grayscale; massive sloping angular shoulder plates with tall pointed inner spikes, layered outer shoulder segments and subtle violet energy translated to light gray; central diamond chest inset and riblike engraved chest shapes; dark fitted undersuit, brown armored hip flaps, flared thick gauntlet cuffs with small inset details, angular knee/shin guards. No helmet, mohawk visible. Reproduce the referenced silhouettes and engraved shapes faithfully while rendering them as detailed hand-painted armor.
Lion: white fur, white and gray full mane, broad feline muzzle, pale eyes, long upper saber fangs as in Echeyakee references. A lion, not a tiger or purple tusked cat. Natural paws, complete anatomy.
Composition: both subjects grouped high toward the RIGHT two thirds with breathing room around heads and shoulders. Quiet LEFT third for addon text. Show kneeling pose and companion, no cropped faces. Detailed painterly Warcraft TCG-style brushwork, expressive forms, moderately increased contrast, rich midtone detail and controlled highlights.
STRICTLY neutral black and white. Bake a wide smooth charcoal gradient into the LEFT edge blending gradually into the scene with no visible seam or vertical strip. Bake a soft dark BOTTOM gradient across the lowest approximately 11 percent fading down to near-black charcoal with no horizontal boundary. Keep lion's white face readable and armor detail clear. No added text, logos, watermark, UI, border, extra people or animals. Do not reproduce any reference screenshot backgrounds or their repeated logos.
